info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Payment By Param1-spec
info.description: The Payment Modification API allows for the adjustment of existing payment transactions based on unique parameters. This API is primarily utilized to alter details of card-based e-commerce payments, providing flexibility for businesses to correct or update transaction data as needed. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and payment processors looking to enhance transaction accuracy and customer satisfaction. The endpoint supports varying modifications, ensuring effective management of payment records while ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Card E-Commerce Gateway payment with the ID CARD-400045. Ensure to provide all necessary information to successfully process the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update payment details for the specified card transaction through the e-commerce gateway. Ensure that you provide all necessary information in the correct format to successfully process the request.
